## 2. Core Philosophy: Browser-First Computing
Modern web browsers are full execution runtimes powered by high-speed V8 engines, WebAssembly, and multi-threaded Web Workers. Girish Lade builds utilities following three inviolable rules:
1. Zero forced authentication: Tools must work instantly without email or credit card gates.
2. Local-only processing: Files remain on the user's hardware. Nothing is uploaded to remote servers.
3. No artificial limits: Operations run at native device speeds without paywalls.

## 3. Flagship Products
### GB Coder (https://gbcoder.ladestack.in)
An in-browser integrated development environment built with Monaco Editor and WebContainers. It executes Node.js environments directly inside Chromium-based sandboxes, allowing users to run npm packages, terminal commands, and local development servers without server-side compute.

### LS PDF (https://lspdf.ladestack.in)
A suite of high-performance PDF manipulation tools that operate 100% inside the client browser. Features include merging, splitting, page rotation, image conversion, and compression, built using Web Workers to prevent main-thread lag.

### LadeStack (https://ladestack.in)
The parent brand and distribution platform for all zero-installation, privacy-respecting browser developer utilities.

## 4. Technical Stack
- Frontend: Astro 7, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Three.js (WebGL 3D graphics).
- Architecture: Static site generation (SSG) with client hydration islands, accessible ARIA dropdowns, and subpath multilingual routing across 9 languages.
- SEO & Agentic Standards: Schema.org JSON-LD (Person, WebSite, BlogPosting), complete XML Sitemap with hreflang alternates, llms.txt, OpenGraph, and Twitter Cards.
